profile_decisions.basis: The related tracks share definitions, sources, and one prospective article-level objective.
The beginner example omits advanced budgeted campaigns; they can be selected for a later project when useful.
The example's null initial_problem and unresolved target question explicitly describe an exploratory start.

unresolved_questions: No exact theorem target has yet been selected.

in_scope: Structural bounds, extremal witnesses, and finite experiments directly tied to the program.
lab.mission: Explore one coherent combinatorial research program and determine which precise article-level claim is viable.
out_of_scope: Independent combinatorics projects without shared definitions or sources.
lab.title: Exploratory Combinatorics Research Laboratory

central_questions: Which structural hypothesis yields the sharpest provable bound?
conventions: All finite parameter ranges must be stated explicitly.

specialist_roles.description: Check structural and extremal combinatorics arguments.
